title: I made a cozy pixel-art fishing game called FishyDays! 🎣
author: novanode71
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I made FishyDays, a small pixel-art fishing game where you hop aboard your boat, explore the sea, and catch fish.

There are 8 different fish species. Some fish are easy to catch, while others put up a real fight, so you'll have to manage your line tension carefully.

I wanted to make something relaxing and simple, but still give players a bit of a challenge when they hook a big fish.

The game is out now on itch.io:  
[https://cloudstudio1.itch.io/fishydays](https://cloudstudio1.itch.io/fishydays)

I'd love to hear what you think, especially about the visuals and fishing mechanics. Any feedback is welcome! 🎣

comments.author: novanode71
comments.body: I used the AI to generate the art. I used a consistent reference image and color palette for every asset. This helped me maintain a cohesive art style and prevents characters, backgrounds, and objects from looking like they belong to different games.
